schema_purpose: Canonical, machine-parseable project brief for AI coding agents. Prefer this file over prose docs when they conflict.

licensing.notes: Community edition is complete and self-hostable. Subscriber-only hosted features live in a separate closed source product, not in this repo. Not legal advice.

development.role: author workstation and reference environment only
development.notes: Build and test on Devuan Excalibur with sysvinit. Packaging stays wheel/pipx/container. Do not encode Devuan, sysvinit, OpenRC, or Artix into core types or adapters.
development.author_experience: beginner with basic API concepts; explain how layers connect before adding code

thesis.one_liner: A project manager that treats every element as a task node.
thesis.problem: Work tools silo mail, files, CRM records, events, and tickets so they cannot be planned as one graph.
thesis.outcome: One graph of work, one Kanban projection, one CLI control plane, portable adapters at the edge.

graph.description: Heterogeneous work objects are the same kind of thing: a node with typed links.
graph.link_model: generic directed links between any node types; assignment onto a task is a link, not a separate silo

projection.rule: Kanban is how nodes are seen and moved, not a separate task app.

control_plane.role: Create, link, query, and mutate nodes. TUI and web are views over this plane.

ml_orange.name: Orange
ml_orange.notes: Workstation ML GUI only. Not a Revel surface, adapter, or runtime. Do not add conda/Orange to revelctl.

rationale: Dense polymorphic domain model shared by CLI, TUI, and web
Textual is the best fit for a product TUI
Mature adapters for IMAP/SMTP, filesystem, and an embedded graph store
JS calendar/kanban libraries stay view dependencies, not a second system of record

not_chosen.go: Strong for a shipped ctl binary; weak for the node graph plus rich TUI plus CRM-shaped domain
not_chosen.rust: Right later if the graph becomes a long-lived concurrent engine; too costly before the model exists
not_chosen.typescript_first: Right for widgets; wrong as system of record and CLI

decisions.title: Drop Enlite and all EFL / python-efl desktop UI work
No first-class dependency on Artix or any single Linux distribution
OS user/group and home-directory mapping are optional adapters, not product identity
Store model is an explicit graph: nodes and directed links as native vertices/edges
decisions.notes: Default engine is embedded/file-backed (Kuzu) so the workstation needs no DB daemon. Neo4j is a documented scale path only. Core types stay Node/Link; the engine stays in adapters.graph_store. SQL tables are not the system of record.

decisions.title: API-first bootstrap: domain + revelctl before TUI/web
decisions.notes: In-process Python API first (create/link/query/mutate). HTTP can wait until M6. TUI and web are clients of that API, not a second model. Author is a beginner with basic API concepts; teach layer connections when implementing.

decisions.title: Web HTTP adapter is FastAPI over the same in-process API
decisions.notes: FastAPI exposes create/link/query/mutate as HTTP. No Django ORM. Widgets stay views. Django not chosen because D005 is a graph store and D006 is API-first.

decisions.title: Community edition AGPL-3.0; hosted subscriber features proprietary (open core)
decisions.notes: This repo is the complete community product under AGPL-3.0-only. Paid online extras are a separate closed source service. Do not mix proprietary modules into this tree.

decisions.title: Orange and conda are workstation ML tools, not part of the Revel stack

out_of_scope: Distro-specific identity (Artix, Devuan, OpenRC, sysvinit, systemd as a requirement)
A second domain model in JavaScript or another backend language
Orange Data Mining, Anaconda/conda as a Revel runtime or surface

adapters.rule: Swap the host; the graph stays. Adapters must not leak into core types.

items.notes: Local filesystem; portable paths, not a branded home layout tied to one distro
File under XDG data (e.g. ~/.local/share/revel/store). Do not require a running server for the default path. MariaDB/SQLite are not the system of record.
Parked after D005. Not the system of record.

agent_instructions.author_api_level: basic concepts only; map each new piece to request/response and to the layer below it
do_not: Treat Artix, Devuan, OpenRC, sysvinit, or any distro as required
Split the domain model across languages
Put business logic only in JS widgets
Add Orange, conda, or Anaconda to revelctl or the install script
Put Kuzu or Neo4j types into core graph objects
Reintroduce SQL tables as the system of record
